adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, the helper uses `safeParse(...)` but then immediately `throw new Error(...)` when `!refreshTokenResponse.success`. That means any return value from this function will always have `success: true`, yet it still returns the `safeParse` wrapper object. As a result, callers like `salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` keep an unreachable `if (!accessTokenParsed.success) ...` check, and `office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` still branches on `.success` when spreading `tokenResponse.data`. This is a real, diff-grounded API/design issue (dead code / confusing return type), but it doesn’t by itself break runtime behavior.
